compatibilityDecisionsProposed.proposal: Keep existing persisted/legacy returned and APIs; introduce orthogonal commercial outcome/custody DTO for new-policy orders; never relabel old records
Retain Money IQD scale1000 canonical arithmetic; whole-IQD wallet conversion exact; no second money representation
Use immutable order lineId with modifier/price snapshot, not productId alone; preserve custody quantity conservation with condition as separate dimension
Actual refund cannot exceed proven collected cash minus prior executed refunds; separately approved goodwill compensation is not a cash refund
Use server authenticated principal for actor/approvedBy; client approvedBy is not authority; no second employee required
Pin exception policy to eligible new order at creation/effectiveFrom; preserve fare accepted snapshot; old test order does not auto acquire new fare
Accrual/approval distinct from available wallet credit and real cash execution; no unbacked credit or new independent ledger
Complete and deploy each authorized staging slice with explicit scope; do not add per-customer test scope; unfinished features remain clearly unavailable
